_comment: Counted ceilings for scripts/check_python_static.py. A check passes when its finding count is <= the ceiling; it fails when the count GROWS. The silent-except ceilings are NOT a defect count: QA R4 audited every such block and deliberately kept these (cancellation-swallowing shutdown, expected chain fall-through, logging infra that would recurse). The ceiling freezes that adjudicated set so a NEW silent broad handler must be reviewed. Lower a ceiling whenever debt is paid down. Baseline taken 2026-10-07 (QA R5).
